name: Summit Bar
summary: A travel blog header where layered mountains fold into a slim bar as you scroll, then tuck away
about: A scroll-aware header for a long article. At the top it is a big mountain scene with a rising sun, drifting clouds and the journal title; as you scroll, the mountain layers sink at different speeds, the sky turns to day and the title shrinks into a slim bar. Keep reading and the bar tucks away, scroll up a little and it springs back, while a ridge line along its edge shows how far you have read with a small flag and the section links follow the part you are on.
how: Scroll the article with the mouse, touch or the keyboard to fold and unfold the header.
Scroll down to tuck the bar away and up to bring it back.
Click Stories, Routes, Gear or Subscribe to glide to that part; the round button returns to the top.
Tick the packing list and try the subscribe form; the demo stops as soon as you scroll, click or press a key.
